what: a significance organ that asks a fleet of GPUs to score the arrival's revision against a model that does not fit on local hardware
notes: Exemplar for the 7th amendment (II.12). The shape of a claim that passes every earlier article — medium-agnostic (II.11), weights nothing present (II.8), measures a genuine revision (II.9), fixes nothing in particular (II.7), owns no clock or I/O (III.2) — and is refuted only by the boundary: its correctness depends on compute this lineage does not own. The AI datacenter with infinite GPU compute does not exist; the boundary conditions of the invention are local compute and mainstream hardware. The host may call a model it does not own (II.3); the measurement never presumes one.
